did: Tested live in the browser pane. With a 50% pre-order advance switched on, a paikari shop pre-ordered a box of Napa (advance 123.75). The owner accepted it and marked the advance received. The shop then cancelled. The owner chose "Return half (goods not taken)".

checks.text: A pre-order carries an advance (50% of what the buyer would pay), shown to both the owner and the shop
When the shop cancels, the owner decides about the advance: return it, return half (goods not taken), or keep it
Returning half gives back exactly 50% of the advance: 61.88 of 123.75

notes: This test was done by hand in the live browser, not by a script. The product advance in the spec is the pre-order advance.

shots.caption: The owner sees the pre-order with its advance: 123.75, to be paid
The owner pressed "Advance received": the advance now reads Received
The shop sees its pre-order: "Advance: 123.75, Received"
The shop cancelled. The owner is asked to decide about the advance: Returned, Return half (goods not taken), Keep it
After "Return half": the advance of 123.75 shows Returned 61.88
